SELECT
    l_returnflag,
    l_linestatus,
    SUM(l_quantity) AS sum_qty,
    SUM(l_extendedprice) AS sum_base_price,
    SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS sum_disc_price,
    SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) AS sum_charge,
    AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty,
    AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price,
    AVG(l_discount) AS avg_disc,
    COUNT(*) AS count_order
FROM lineitem
WHERE l_receiptdate <= '1998-09-02'
GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus
ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus

WITH global_min_costs AS (
    SELECT
        ps.ps_partkey,
        MIN(ps.ps_supplycost) AS min_supply_cost
    FROM partsupp ps
    JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
    GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey
)
SELECT
    s.s_acctbal,
    s.s_name,
    n.n_name,
    p.p_partkey,
    p.p_mfgr,
    s.s_address,
    s.s_phone,
    s.s_comment
FROM supplier s
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN global_min_costs gmc ON ps.ps_partkey = gmc.ps_partkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
  AND p.p_size = 15
  AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%'
  AND ps.ps_supplycost = gmc.min_supply_cost
ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC, n.n_name, s.s_name, p.p_partkey

        ```sql
    s.s_name,
    s.s_address,
        ```

1. Filters line items shipped in the quarter starting 1993-10-01 (on or after 1993-10-01 and before 1994-01-01)
2. Filters for returned line items (return flag 'R')
3. For each customer, calculates:
   - customer key
   - customer name
   - lost revenue (sum of extended price * (1 - discount) over returned items)
   - account balance
   - nation name
   - address
   - phone
   - comment

3. Join customer with nation on c_nationkey = n_nationkey
4. Filter where l_shipdate is between 1993-10-01 and 1994-01-01 (quarter 1993)

```sql
        ps.ps_suppkey,
```
        ps.ps_partkey,
        SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_qty

```sql
FROM qualified_partsupp qs
```

```sql
        SELECT
```
            s.s_acctbal,
            s.s_name,
            n.n_name,
            p.p_partkey,
            p.p_mfgr,
            s.s_address,
            s.s_phone,
            s.s_comment

WITH customer_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        c.c_custkey,
        COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count
    FROM customer c
    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    WHERE o.o_comment NOT LIKE '%special%requests%'
    GROUP BY c.c_custkey
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS c_count,
    SUM(order_count) AS custdist
FROM customer_orders
GROUP BY order_count
ORDER BY c_count DESC, custdist DESC

```sql
WITH customer_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        c.c_custkey,
        COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count
    FROM customer c
    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    WHERE o.o_comment NOT LIKE '%special%requests%'
    GROUP BY c.c_custkey
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS c_count,
    SUM(order_count) AS custdist
FROM customer_orders
GROUP BY order_count
ORDER BY c_count DESC, custdist DESC;
```

WITH supplier_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        s.s_suppkey,
        s.s_name
    FROM supplier s
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    WHERE n.n_name = 'SAUDI ARABIA'
),
waiting_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        lo.l_orderkey,
        lo.l_suppkey,
        lo.l_linenumber,
        lo.l_receiptdate,
        lo.l_commitdate
    FROM lineitem lo
    JOIN orders o ON lo.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F'
        AND lo.l_receiptdate > lo.l_commitdate
),
different_supplier_waiting AS (
    SELECT 
        w1.l_orderkey,
        w1.l_suppkey AS supplier_key
    FROM waiting_orders w1
    WHERE w1.l_orderkey IN (
        SELECT 
            o2.o_orderkey
        FROM orders o2
        WHERE o2.o_orderstatus = 'F'
            AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM lineitem l2
                WHERE l2.l_orderkey = o2.o_orderkey
                    AND l2.l_suppkey != w1.l_suppkey
                    AND l2.l_receiptdate > l2.l_commitdate
            )
    )
)
SELECT 
    so.s_name,
    COUNT(*) AS numwait
FROM supplier_orders so
JOIN different_supplier_waiting ds ON so.s_suppkey = ds.supplier_key
GROUP BY so.s_name
ORDER BY numwait DESC, so.s_name ASC
```sql
LIMIT 100;
```

SELECT

    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) - ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS sum_profit
FROM

JOIN

JOIN

   ```sql
JOIN

JOIN
   ```
    nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey

WHERE
    p.p_name LIKE '%green%'
GROUP BY
    n.n_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)

    ```sql
SELECT
    ```
    p_brand,
    p_type,
    p_size,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt
FROM part
JOIN partsupp ON part.p_partkey = partsupp.ps_partkey
JOIN supplier ON partsupp.ps_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey
WHERE
    p_brand <> 'Brand#45'
    AND p_type NOT LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED%'
    AND p_size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
    AND s_comment <> '%Customer%Complaints%'
    AND s_acctbal > 0
GROUP BY
    p_brand,
    p_type,
    p_size
ORDER BY
    supplier_cnt DESC,
    p_brand ASC,
    p_type ASC,
    p_size ASC
